_note: How-to-play wizard. Upper case only, and only characters in the 5x7 font charset: A-Z 0-9 / - . , ' ! & + : % ?. Keep body lines to 24 characters and titles to 12, or they will not fit the plate.

pages.title: THE DEBT
pages.body:
YOU OWE THE HOUSE.
THE WHEEL IS HOW YOU
PAY IT DOWN.
THE CROUPIER ONLY
TURNS IT.

pages.title: THE SPIN
pages.body:
TAP SPIN.
THE TICKER LANDS ON A
WEDGE.
GOLD PAYS. RED TAKES.

pages.title: THE CHAIN
pages.body:
3 REWARDS IN A ROW
STARTS A CHAIN.
EACH ONE ADDS +0.25X,
UP TO 3X.
ANY RISK WIPES IT.

pages.title: THE NOTICE
pages.body:
THE EYE FILLS AS YOU
SPIN AND TITHE.
WHEN FULL, THE NEXT
RISK WEDGE SUMMONS
A SIN.

pages.title: THE QUOTA
pages.body:
EACH RUN OWES A QUOTA.
PAY IT: THE DEBT FALLS.
MISS IT: THE DEBT
GROWS AND THE HOUSE
ADDS A WOUND.

pages.title: THE TITHE
pages.body:
TITHE PAYS HALF YOUR
PURSE AND YOU KEEP
SPINNING - BUT THE EYE
OPENS WIDER.
BANK TAKES ALL.

pages.title: THE SEVEN
pages.body:
SINS COME BECAUSE YOU
ARE DOING WELL.
EACH CAN BE BROKEN -
THE STRIP SAYS HOW.
BREAK IT, KEEP THE BOON.

pages.title: THE FORGE
pages.body:
BETWEEN RUNS, TAKE ONE
OF THREE CARDS: ADD,
STRIKE OR TEMPER.
THE RING IS YOUR BUILD.

pages.title: WALK AWAY
pages.body:
RESILIENCE HITS ZERO
AND THE PURSE IS LOST.
KNOW WHEN TO WALK.
SIT.
